# Fabric

> Fabric is an AI-assisted operating system for private schools: admissions, attendance, fees, exams and results, assignments, a school website CMS, and notifications in one multi-tenant, permission-checked workspace.

This file is optional documentation for AI agents and crawlers. Nothing here guarantees search ranking or citation. If this file and a public page disagree, the page is correct.

## Capabilities
- Admissions, attendance, fees, exams and results, assignments, school website CMS, notifications.
- Fee payments run through Razorpay in test mode only.
- Email and WhatsApp notifications are simulated until a channel is configured.
- AI features are permission-checked; a human reviews and saves AI output. Insights, forecasts and agents require human approval.
- Multi-tenant isolation with row-level security; audit log of sensitive actions.

## Not available
AI credits or bring-your-own-key, voice, what-if simulation, marketplace purchasing.

## Not for crawling
Signed-in app routes, /api, /login, /select, /portal. See /robots.txt.
